cell_ledger.cell_id_format: CMP followed by a three-digit one-based integer
cell_ledger.cell_master_seed_integer: digest interpreted as unsigned 256-bit big-endian integer

rng.outer_substream_preimage: UTF8(seed_namespace) || NUL || UTF8(cell_id) || NUL || UTF8(OUTER) || NUL || ASCII six-digit zero-padded outer_index || NUL || UTF8(stream_label)
data_draw_order: standard_normal float64 shape (R,4) in C order for model-specific root effects
standard_normal float64 shape (R,8,4) in C order for model-specific task effects
standard_normal float64 shape (R,8,20,4) in C order for model-specific cell effects

hierarchical_gaussian_law.component_independence: all A, B, and E entries are mutually independent across every distinct index and component

C02.name: ALIGNED_STRONG_ICC_UNEQUAL_SUPPORT_GAUSSIAN_GLOBAL_NULL
C02.root_icc_definition: Corr(Y[r,t,c,m],Y[r,t_prime,c_prime,m]) for t != t_prime equals v_root/(v_root+v_task+v_cell)=0.8
C02.observed_cells: for task t, retain nominal zero-based cell indices c < observed_cell_count[t]

calibration.calibration_level: one equal-cell-within-task and equal-task-within-root utility contrast
calibration.nonadjacent_mean_gaps: integer multiples of the adjacent gap

aggregation_and_analysis_rows.task_utility: Q[r,t,m] = arithmetic mean of observed Y[r,t,c,m] over retained c
aggregation_and_analysis_rows.root_utility: U[r,m] = arithmetic mean of Q[r,t,m] over the 8 tasks
aggregation_and_analysis_rows.top_level_point_mean: G[m] = arithmetic mean of U[r,m] over R roots
aggregation_and_analysis_rows.root_bootstrap_rows: the R paired four-model vectors U[r,:]
aggregation_and_analysis_rows.task_bootstrap_rows: the 8R paired four-model vectors Q[r,t,:] in r-then-t order
aggregation_and_analysis_rows.cell_bootstrap_pseudo_utility: Z[r,t,c,m] = N_observed/(R*8*n_t) * Y[r,t,c,m] for retained c
aggregation_and_analysis_rows.cell_bootstrap_rows: the N_observed paired four-model vectors Z in r-then-t-then-c order
aggregation_and_analysis_rows.observed_mean_identity: the arithmetic model mean of root rows, task rows, and scaled cell rows is the same equal-root/equal-task point mean up to frozen float64 evaluation order
aggregation_and_analysis_rows.missing_support_denominator: n_t from the deterministic law-specific mask; no imputation and no adaptive deletion

numerical_evaluation_contract.task_means: numpy.mean on each contiguous retained float64 cell slice with dtype=numpy.float64
numerical_evaluation_contract.root_means: numpy.mean over the ordered 8 by 4 task-mean array on axis 0 with dtype=numpy.float64
numerical_evaluation_contract.top_level_means: numpy.mean over the ordered R by 4 root-utility array on axis 0 with dtype=numpy.float64
numerical_evaluation_contract.bootstrap_row_column_means: numpy.mean over the ordered N by 4 analysis-row array on axis 0 with dtype=numpy.float64
numerical_evaluation_contract.bootstrap_resample_means: numpy.mean of rows selected by each ordered index-matrix row on its resampled-row axis with dtype=numpy.float64
numerical_evaluation_contract.observed_point_contrast_for_all_mean_pro: G[winner]-G[loser] from the single frozen top_level_means computation
numerical_evaluation_contract.comparison_operators: strict greater-than for point utility direction; greater-than-or-equal for bootstrap tail and Holm threshold; exact equality for point maximum ties and V3 root ties
numerical_evaluation_contract.nonfinite_value_policy: fail the outer replicate without replacement; the cell integrity gate consequently fails

estimands.EXACT_ROOT_SIGN_HOLM: theta[a,b]=P(U[r,a]>U[r,b] conditional on U[r,a]!=U[r,b]) across independent roots with common sign probability
estimands.TASK_NEGATIVE_CONTROL_BOOTSTRAP_MEAN_CON: same observed equal-root/equal-task mean contrast, but invalid uncertainty calculation treats dependent task descendants as independent
estimands.CELL_NEGATIVE_CONTROL_BOOTSTRAP_MEAN_CON: same observed equal-root/equal-task mean contrast through fixed pseudo-utility scaling, but invalid uncertainty calculation treats dependent cell descendants as independent

bootstrap_contract.index_matrix: for N analysis rows, draw one int64 matrix of shape (499,N), independently with replacement from [0,N)
bootstrap_contract.complete_family_sharing: the same index matrix is used for all four model columns and all 12 ordered contrasts within that procedure and outer replicate
bootstrap_contract.centering: subtract each observed model-column mean from every row before resampling; ordered centered contrast bootstrap means are differences of resampled centered model-column means
bootstrap_contract.observed_ordered_contrast: G[winner]-G[loser] from the single equal-root/equal-task top-level point-mean computation, shared by all mean procedures
bootstrap_contract.tail_comparison: centered bootstrap ordered contrast mean >= observed ordered contrast
bootstrap_contract.p_value: (1 + number of the 499 tail comparisons that are true) / 500
bootstrap_contract.p_value_arithmetic_for_holm: authoritative integer numerator over common denominator 500

root_cr1_t_contract.analysis_rows: one ordered contrast U[r,a]-U[r,b] per independent root
root_cr1_t_contract.statistic: sample mean divided by sample standard deviation with denominator R-1 divided by sqrt(R)
root_cr1_t_contract.cr1_equivalence: intercept-only regression on the R root rows with CR1 multiplier R/(R-1)
root_cr1_t_contract.one_sided_p_value: Student-t survival probability at the statistic
root_cr1_t_contract.zero_standard_error: set p=1, set statistic=0, emit zero_standard_error_fail_closed=true, and do not reject
root_cr1_t_contract.student_t_implementation: comparator_numerics_v1.student_t_survival using regularized incomplete beta and Python standard library only

holm_contract.step_down_rule: sort ascending p then lexicographic hypothesis ID; at zero-based step i reject while p_i <= (1/20)/(12-i), and stop at the first failure
holm_contract.exact_root_sign: delegate to the frozen V3 core exact-rational Holm
holm_contract.bootstrap: compare common-denominator integer numerators by integer cross multiplication
holm_contract.root_cr1_t: binary64 p-values from comparator_numerics_v1 with deterministic p-then-ID sort and binary64 threshold comparison
holm_contract.opposite_rejected_directions: numerical contract violation; fail the outer replicate and therefore fail the cell without replacement

procedures.algorithm: frozen V3 core on the R by 1 by 4 root utility tensor under the common-sign regime
frozen centered root-row bootstrap contract and exact common-denominator Holm
frozen one-sample root-contrast t contract and deterministic float64 Holm
frozen centered task-row bootstrap contract and exact common-denominator Holm
frozen centered scaled-cell-row bootstrap contract and exact common-denominator Holm
select the largest G[m]; on exact binary64 equality select the lexicographically smallest model ID and count the tie event

graph_contract.mechanical_conversion: each Holm-rejected ordered hypothesis adds winner-to-loser edge; use frozen V3 core source-set, SCC-cycle, and direct-Condorcet combinatorics
graph_contract.direct_condorcet: one model with direct outgoing edges to every other model
graph_contract.cycle: at least one strongly connected component with more than one model

C01_and_C02.null_ordered_hypotheses: all 12 ordered directions for both sign and equal-root mean objects

C03_and_C04.alignment_boundary: sign and equal-root mean truths point in the same directions, but their scores remain separately labelled

counts_only_shard_contract.zero_standard_error_fields: must be zero for every procedure except ROOT_CR1_T_MEAN_CONTRAST_HOLM
counts_only_shard_contract.all_true_directions_nonvacuous: must be zero by definition when a law has no true-alternative directions

count_definitions.counting_population: successful outer replicates only for every scientific field; failed replicates appear only in failed_replicates and failure_reason_fields
count_definitions.outer_replicates_no_rejections: number of successful outer replicates with zero Holm-rejected directions for that procedure
count_definitions.outer_replicates_any_null_direction_reje: number of successful outer replicates with at least one rejection in the law-specific frozen null-direction set
count_definitions.null_direction_rejections_total: sum across successful outer replicates of the number of rejected directions in the law-specific frozen null-direction set
count_definitions.outer_replicates_any_true_direction_reje: number of successful outer replicates with at least one rejection in the law-specific frozen true-alternative set; exactly zero by definition when that set is empty
count_definitions.true_direction_rejections_total: sum across successful outer replicates of the number of rejected directions in the law-specific frozen true-alternative set; exactly zero when that set is empty
count_definitions.outer_replicates_all_true_directions_rej: number of successful outer replicates rejecting all six frozen true-alternative directions for C03/C04; exactly zero by definition for C01/C02
count_definitions.outer_replicates_graph_cycle: number of successful outer replicates whose mechanical rejection graph has a strongly connected component of size greater than one
count_definitions.outer_replicates_any_direct_condorcet: number of successful outer replicates with exactly one model having direct rejected edges to all three competitors
count_definitions.outer_replicates_target_direct_condorcet: number of successful outer replicates whose direct Condorcet model is M01 for C03/C04; exactly zero by definition for C01/C02
count_definitions.outer_replicates_nontarget_direct_condor: number of successful outer replicates with a direct Condorcet model other than M01 for C03/C04; for C01/C02 every direct Condorcet is nontarget
count_definitions.reported_graph_source_set_size_counts_0_: five-bin histogram with one entry per successful outer replicate, including source size four when there are no rejected edges
count_definitions.zero_standard_error_ordered_tests_total: number of ordered root CR1 tests that invoked the zero-SE fail-closed rule; exactly zero for all non-CR1 procedures
count_definitions.outer_replicates_any_zero_standard_error: successful outer replicates with at least one zero-SE ordered root CR1 test; exactly zero for all non-CR1 procedures
count_definitions.ordered_root_non_ties_total: V3 only: number of ordered-hypothesis by root comparisons with unequal float64 root utilities
count_definitions.ordered_root_ties_total: V3 only: number of ordered-hypothesis by root comparisons with exactly equal float64 root utilities
count_definitions.selection_counts_M01_to_M04: four-bin histogram with one selected model per successful outer replicate
count_definitions.target_model_selections: selection count for M01 in C03/C04; exactly zero by definition for C01/C02
count_definitions.exact_maximum_tie_break_events: successful outer replicates in which at least two model point means equal the maximum exactly in float64 before lexicographic selection

accounting_identities_per_inferential_pr: null_direction_rejections_total plus true_direction_rejections_total is at most 12 times successful_replicates
event counts are each between zero and successful_replicates inclusive
direction-total counts are each between zero and the corresponding frozen direction-set size times successful_replicates inclusive
accounting_identities_global: V3 ordered_root_non_ties_total plus ordered_root_ties_total equals 12 times R times successful_replicates
for each non-CR1 procedure both zero-standard-error fields equal zero

claim_boundary.purpose: finite source-free descriptive comparison of declared analysis-unit choices under four aligned Gaussian laws
